page.layout: One page of text, with a running head and page number at the top; a marginal note at the right margin ("Fio.", "Fiebam.", "Facta sum", "Facta fue-ram"), set beside the verb lines. Below the running head: heading "PASSIVUM.", then paragraph-like blocks of Greek verb forms as lines.
page.notes: Greek verb forms transcribed as closely as the scan allows; accents and breathings in the lower lines are doubtful and marked by reading from the printed shapes. The marginal notes "Fio.", "Fiebam.", "Facta sum" and "Facta fueram" are set at the right beside the lines. Faint show-through from the reverse page is ignored.
